page.overview:
Who is Agrammon?

Agrammon, called "The Cagelord," was a Daemon Prince of Slaanesh whose main interest was a large and ever-expanding collection of exotic beasts.

Taking up residence in the Southern Wastes of Chaos, Agrammon's armies of Beastfiends and Daemons waged destructive campaigns across the wastes in order to capture exotic monsters and deliver them to the citadel of their master. It said that every type of beast imaginable could be found in Agrammon's citadel.

Once they were captured, the Daemon Prince did not care about its prizes, letting them waste away in their cages that lined his palace. It was here that the thirteenth Everchosen Archaon found Dorghar, the Steed of the Apocalypse, after unleashing several of the monsters imprisoned there that vented their fury on Agrammon's Daemonette and Beastfiend servants. In his personal throne room, the prize specimens were impaled, hanging in torment and ecstasy until their forms expired. Archaon faced the Daemon Prince there and Agrammon was slain when a freed Slaughterbrute charged it and ripped it asunder, weakening the Daemon enough that Archaon could finish him.

Agrammon was a serpentine, hermaphroditic horror, its face holding unspeakable beauty that trailed into a pair of sweeping horns and a nest of long tentacles. Its body was constantly dripping with ooze, keeping it slick, while the Daemon Prince's body produced the ecstatic poison that kept his prisoners sedate by turning pain into pleasure. The Daemon Prince's upper body clicked with chitinous claws and pincers that constantly pierced its flesh, only to heal again quickly. Its arms each ended in three pairs of clawed hands, one after the other. In battle, the Daemon Prince was able to transform its secretions into acid.
